name: That's just it
description: Pepe at a podium, caption 'That's just it'. Calm 'that is the whole point / nothing else to add'.
whenToUse: When wrapping a point, agreeing that a simple explanation is enough, or saying there is no extra wahala: that's just it, na the thing, 'that's all'. Softer than gbam (gbam is punchy; this is a clean close).
whenNotToUse: Skip if the topic is still open or they asked for more detail. Not for shock or greetings.
